title: specularia speculum-veneris subsp. hirta
intro: Specularia speculum-veneris subsp. hirta, commonly known as the 'Wild Foxglove', is a species of flowering plant in the family Plantaginaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The health benefits of Specularia speculum-veneris subsp. hirta include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing skin irritations and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, such as aucubin and speculine, which exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
